name: Maddie's Summer
source:
Maddie’s Summer isn’t here to tell a deep emotional story… It’s here to deliver a summer packed with erotic tension, temptation, and forbidden desire, brought to life with stunning 3D visuals and smooth animations created in Honey Select 2. 

You play as a young man spending his vacation at Maddie and Richard’s house — a situation that slowly transforms into a dangerous game of seduction, guilt, and desire.

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/posts/download-all-my-148815117]Patreon[/url]]

《麦迪的夏天》并不是要讲述一个深刻的情感故事……而是要讲述一个充满色情紧张、诱惑和禁忌欲望的夏天，通过Honey Select 2中创建的令人惊叹的3D视觉效果和流畅的动画将其带入生活。

你扮演一个年轻人，在麦迪和理查德的家里度假——这种情况慢慢转变为一场充满诱惑、内疚和欲望的危险游戏。
